items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: “Mercy Mercy Mercy” Joe Zawinul arranged by P. Wilson.

ctx.x: Right. Well they went on to better days maybe in an area that they were working on. There aren’t many Makotos in this world but there are a lot of people who have really good talent, fun to listen to, but the act isn’t complete. Let’s put it that way, for one reason or another. Maybe the individual wasn’t that much into it or willing to deal with the realities of life as a traveling performer or something like that. Or sometimes they don’t have the skills to play shows and things like that, so you try to steer,…

I wanted to show you, I came across a program of a local high school band, this is in Central New York, the Whitesboro Jazz Ensemble concert, July 15, 1969. And the first piece on it — “Mercy Mercy Mercy” Joe Zawinul arranged by P. Wilson.
